title: Your schedule on phone and tablet
subtitle: Check today’s appointments and see who is coming next.
text:
Clientbridge keeps your schedule available on your phone and tablet.

Use the tablet view to see the team’s appointments across the day. On your phone, check your schedule and see who is coming next.

These screens show examples from our demo accounts.

You’ll find the link to learn more in the first comment.
repost: A look at scheduling in Clientbridge on a phone and tablet. The tablet gives you room to see the team’s day, while the phone keeps upcoming appointments close by.

title: Client details where you need them
subtitle: Find a client, open their record, and check the details before their visit.
text:
Clientbridge brings your client list and client records together.

On a tablet, you can keep the list open beside the selected client’s details. On your phone, find a client and open their record while you’re away from your desk.

The screens show demo client records.

You’ll find the link to learn more in the first comment.
repost: In Clientbridge, you can check a client’s details from your phone or keep their record open beside the client list on a tablet. Useful when you’re getting ready for the next visit.

title: Invoices at your desk and on your phone
subtitle: Review invoices in the app and let clients pay through a link.
text:
With Clientbridge, you can review invoices on your computer or phone and send clients a link to pay.

The client’s page shows what the invoice is for and the amount due, with card payment on the same page.

These examples show the business view and a client payment page from our demo accounts.

You’ll find the link to learn more in the first comment.
repost: A look at both sides of invoicing in Clientbridge: reviewing invoices on a computer or phone, and the page a client opens to pay.

title: Before the client arrives
subtitle: Clients can fill out a form, sign an agreement, and review their booking from a link.
text:
Clientbridge gives clients a way to handle the details before their visit.

They can fill out a form, sign an agreement, or review their booking through a link. They can also move or cancel a booking within the business’s policy.

These screens show separate examples from our demo businesses.

You’ll find the link to learn more in the first comment.
repost: Forms, agreements, and booking details are all things a client can handle before arriving. Here’s how those pages look in Clientbridge.

title: A payment page for your business
subtitle: Clients can review their invoice and pay by card on their phone.
text:
Clientbridge lets clients pay an invoice from a link on their phone.

The page carries your business’s branding and shows the invoice details and amount due. Clients can pay by card without installing an app or creating an account.

Here are examples from three of our demo businesses.

You’ll find the link to learn more in the first comment.
repost: These are Clientbridge’s payment pages for three demo businesses. Clients open a link, review the invoice, and pay by card without creating an account.

title: Your shop on desktop and mobile
subtitle: Clients can browse products and place an order through your business’s page.
text:
Clientbridge gives your business an online shop that clients can use on their computer or phone.

They can browse your products, check prices, and place an order for pickup. The shop sits alongside your booking page.

These screens show examples from a demo business.

You’ll find the link to learn more in the first comment.
repost: The shop in Clientbridge works on desktop and mobile. Clients can browse products, place an order for pickup, and check its progress on the order page.

title: Booking with your business
subtitle: Your services, prices, and appointment lengths, ready for clients to choose.
text:
Clientbridge gives clients a booking page with your services, prices, and appointment lengths.

They can see which services require a deposit and read your cancellation notice before choosing a visit.

These examples show a photographer, a massage clinic, and a hair studio from our demo businesses.

You’ll find the link to learn more in the first comment.
repost: A few examples of booking pages in Clientbridge. Each business has its own services, prices, deposits, and cancellation notice.

title: A shop for the products you sell
subtitle: Clients can browse your products and order for pickup from their phone.
text:
Clientbridge lets clients shop for products through your business’s page.

Your products appear with their photos, prices, and categories. Clients can add items to an order and arrange pickup.

These examples show home supplies, tattoo aftercare, and hair care from three demo businesses.

You’ll find the link to learn more in the first comment.
repost: Here’s how different product ranges look in Clientbridge’s mobile shop. Clients can browse what a business sells and place an order for pickup.

title: Estimates, payments, and receipts
subtitle: Clear details clients can open from a link on their phone.
text:
Clientbridge gives clients pages for reviewing an estimate, paying an invoice, and viewing a receipt.

They can check the work and costs on the estimate, pay by card on the invoice page, and see what was paid on the receipt.

These are separate examples from Northlight Security, one of our demo businesses.

You’ll find the link to learn more in the first comment.
repost: A closer look at Clientbridge’s estimate, payment, and receipt pages. Each gives the client the details they need through a link on their phone.
